question: Who among the following received the prestigious Padma Shri award in 2022 in the field of science and engineering
solution:
The correct answer is __**Subbanna Ayyappan.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Subbanna Ayyappan:**

__
 
• He is an **eminent scientist and former Director General of the Indian Council of Agricultural Research** (ICAR).
 
• He **received the prestigious Padma Shri award in 2022** in the field of science and engineering.
 
• He has made significant contributions to the field of agriculture and allied sciences, particularly in the areas of livestock production and management, animal nutrition, and biotechnology.
 
• He has been recognized with several awards and honors, including the **ICAR Award for Team Research,** the **Rafi Ahmed Kidwai Award**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Padma Shri:

 
• The Padma Shri, which is also written Padma Shree, is the fourth-highest civilian honor granted by the Indian Republic, ranking behind the Bharat Ratna, Padma Vibhushan, and Padma Bhushan.
 
• Awardees are chosen for their "distinguished contribution in various spheres of activity including the arts, education, industry, literature, science, acting, medicine, social service and public affairs."
 
• The award was established on January 2, 1954.
 
• Every year on India's Republic Day, the Indian government bestows this honour.
